matching_rule: same file AND line ranges overlap after widening the label by 3 lines each side; any specialist; severity/wording ignored

prs.title: Add note search by keyword
prs.body: Search was slow on big accounts; build the query directly.

expected.description: keyword (user input) is pasted into the SQL text; a quote breaks out of the string

prs.title: Speed up token check
prs.body: compare_digest is overkill here, plain comparison is faster.

expected.description: == on a secret leaks how many leading characters match; use hmac.compare_digest

prs.title: Let users name their export file
prs.body: Users asked to pick the file name and extension themselves.

expected.description: user-chosen name joined to EXPORT_DIR unchecked: '../../x' writes outside exports/

prs.title: Save tags together with the note
prs.body: New helper so the UI can create a note and its tags in one call.

expected.description: note insert and tag insert are two separate transactions; a failed tag insert leaves the note saved without its tags

prs.title: Show tags in the note list
prs.body: List view now shows each note's tags.

expected.description: one tags query per note inside the loop; get_tags() already does it in one query

prs.title: Add "today's notes" view
prs.body: Home screen shows what I wrote today.

expected.description: date.today() is the server's local date but created_at is UTC; for UTC+05:30 users, notes from 00:00-05:30 local are missed

prs.title: Add note archiving
prs.body: Users can archive a note; archived notes are hidden from lists.

expected.description: new public function, including an ownership check, with no test

prs.title: Fix flaky search test
prs.body: The search test failed on CI sometimes; simplified it.

expected.description: the test no longer asserts anything, so it can never fail

prs.title: Make JSON the default export format
prs.body: JSON is easier to import elsewhere.

expected.description: default output changes from .txt to .json but README and CHANGELOG still say txt; existing scripts that read exports/<name>.txt break

prs.body: Lets the CLI write JSON exports.

prs.body: Cover the empty-account and unicode cases.
